name: AssignmentFilterTemplate
label: Assignment Filter Template
helpText: Deploy Intune assignment filters from CIPP templates. An existing filter with the same name is updated field-by-field.
executiveText: Deploys standardized Intune assignment filters that control which devices and users policies apply to. Consistent filters across tenants keep policy targeting predictable and auditable.
docsDescription: Deploy an Intune assignment filter from a CIPP template. The standard grades presence by display name plus the filter's writable fields - description, platform, rule and management type - and remediation creates the filter or patches only the fields that drifted.
